# Audience

## Reader
Experienced engineers and engineering leaders at mid-size software
companies. Technically literate, skeptical, allergic to marketing
language. They scan first and commit to reading only if the first
two sentences earn it. Assume familiarity with Git, HTTP, CI/CD,
and the basic shape of a monorepo; do not assume prior exposure
to specific frameworks or vendors.

# Research Sources

## Sources
- hn.algolia.com — check what the audience has already discussed on the topic
- martinfowler.com/bliki — canonical treatments of software engineering ideas
- Broader web for counterarguments and factual verification
